about: Questions for the iMessage chat agent with the figures a correct answer must contain. Figures come from the tools over the demo farm (snapshot v1). Every reply must also stay under 400 characters unless a case sets maxChars; maxFigures caps how many figures a reply may give (0 for small talk: nothing unprompted). Run: bun run ask --eval
